title: Koofe me dard o gham ki ajab chagayi faza
body:
KOOFE MEIN DARD-O-GHAM KI AJAB CHHAGAYI FAZA, DOOBA HUA HAIN KHOON MEIN SAB FARQE MURTAZA
KOOFE KE BEKASO THA DAR PAR EK ISDEHAAM, BAITUL SHARAF THA BANGAYA MATAM SARA TAMAM, SAB KO DILASA DETE THE SAR THAM KAR IMAM, SAIDANIYO KE LAB PA THA BAS WA MUSIBATA
PEHLU BADAL BADAL KE TADAPTE THE MURTUZA, GEHRA HAI ZAKHM AB NA GIZA HAI NA HAI DAWA, BABA KO DEKH DEKH KE ROTE HAIN MUJTABA, SAR PEET KAR LAHAD MEIN TADAPTI HAIN FATIMA
HASNAIN ROKE KEHTE THE BABA NA JAIYYE, HUM GHAM ZADOON KO ITNA NA BABA RULAIYE, JATE HO KIS PA CHOOD KE BABA BATAIYE, KIS TARHA HOGA HUMSE YATEEMI KA SAMNA
PHIR DIL KAR HUSSAIN KE RUQ PAR NAZAR IMAM, BOLE TU ZIBHA HOYEGA KARBAL MEIN TASHNA KAAM, ASHOOR KO LOOTE GA TERA GHAR GHAR TAMAM, NAMOOS KE SARO SE BHI CHEEN JAYEGI RIDA
BHUKO KA BEKASO KA SAHARA NAHI RAHA, PEETO SAR APNE MOULA HAMARA NAHI RAHA, AB TO SOHAIL ZABT KA YAARA NAHI RAHA, UTHTA HAIN AB JANAZA WASIYE RASOOL KA..
